All of them offer a range of vegetarian dishes, and many have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate special requests. | Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact & Website | |------------|--------------|------------------------|-------------------| | **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Phone: (312) 555‑1234
Website: [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | | **Siam Square** | River North | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Phone: (312) 555‑5678
Website: [siamsquarechicago.com](https://www.siamsquarechicago.com) | | **Thai Orchid** | Lincoln Park | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Satay* | Phone: (312) 555‑9012

Website: [mangotreewickerpark.com](https://www.mangotreewickerpark.com) | | **Lanna Thai** | South Side (near Bronzeville) | *Vegetarian Pad Pakora*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Sticky Rice* | Phone: (312) 555‑7890

If you’re looking for vegan options, look for “vegan” or “no egg/no dairy” tags. 2. **Call Ahead** – Especially for larger groups or if you have dietary restrictions (e.g., nut allergies), it’s a good idea to call ahead and confirm that they can accommodate your needs. 3. **Make Reservations** – If you’re planning a dinner party or a special event, book a table in advance. Many of these restaurants accept reservations via their websites or through OpenTable. ### Need Directions or Reservations?
